Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The before and after images are now in the PR body. I checked both images. They show the skim order controls, tab fields, and captured-piece control. This completes the request in the previous review.

The controls edit the operation draft. Apply uses the existing command and validation. Tests check undo, named errors, list limits, and unknown condition IDs. No blocking defect was found in this PR.

Local results after a trial merge with upstream/main at c5ac1057dcbaae9f8aae887ae835f43dac355989:
- Trial merge: passed, with no conflicts.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- UI library: 793 passed, 5 ignored, 0 failed. All six new tests passed.
- `boundary`: 3 passed; `boundary_picks`: 6 passed; `sinker_setup`: 1 passed; `theme_files`: 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: failed on two items from main. The same command on main alone failed with the same errors:

```text
error: constant `PNG_256` is never used
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:12:7
error: function `taskbar_icon` is never used
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:40:8
```

These lines are outside this PR. With only the `dead_code` lint allowed, clippy passed on the trial merge: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings -A dead_code`. The strict clippy check still needs a fix on main.

Requested before merge: none for this PR.

This change adds UI controls for existing parameters. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. No goldens changed. No mutation tests were run for this UI change. No GUI or GitHub runner was used. No source code was edited during this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
